x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: Given a computer CI is created by Discovery or a connector, When the model category creates assets, Then exactly one hardware asset links to it Given an asset is retired, When its state changes, Then the CI install status follows per the asset–CI synchronisation rules
x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.title: Hardware assets and CIs stay in one-to-one sync with consistent status
